$comment: What this repository contributes to a running stack, and what a check may
believe about it. Same two buckets as vouchryx and costcrew: `checked` is
proved against this repository by internal/manifest/manifest_test.go in this
repository's own CI, `declared` is a statement nobody can verify and carries
THE CLASS HERE IS `daemon`, AND IT IS THE THIRD SHAPE THIS SCHEMA HAS NEEDED.
`service` means a socket somebody can probe; `tool` runs and exits. heraldyx
does neither: it runs forever, polls files and sends mail, and opens no
listener at all. So it declares no listen_default and no health_path, which
is why stack-up registers it without a wait_health and stack-single gives it
no ports. A manifest that invented a health path for it would be a lie that
reads as more assurance than the truth.
AND ITS RUN-PROOF IS THE OPPOSITE OF VOUCHRYX'S. vouchryx must REFUSE without
each of six variables. heraldyx has no required variable at all: every one
either has a default or is genuinely optional, and the thing worth proving is
that it comes up with an EMPTY environment and stays up. stack-single says
why that matters in its own comment: a box that never configured mail must
still come up. Two services, opposite correct behaviour, and no check that
reads source could tell you which is which.

it_opens_no_listener.why: There is no socket, so there is nothing to probe and nothing this repository could assert about a port. A launcher that wanted a readiness signal would have to read the process's own log, which is what stack-up does by registering the pid without a wait_health.

mail_is_the_side_effect_and_it_is_not_ru.why: The run-proof starts the process and watches it stay up. It does not send mail: doing so would need an SMTP server in CI or would prove only that the file sink works, and neither is the claim this manifest makes.
